title: Telex Application Client (supported long-lived application integration)
summary: The supported Application Client core and Rust-first binding are complete. Issue #152 and its bundle-first task make client-conformance ready but unlaunched to prove the ten accepted families across SQLite and credentialed Postgres through the public Rust surface. The consumer-integration gate and supported-client checkpoint remain planned; Watcher and Operator Station retain direct conformance holds and also wait for exact-head consumer attestations.

nodes.title: Converge shared Application Client contract
nodes.summary: Completed through issue #118 and clean PR #126 (merge 62c2b23): API-neutral contract, ADR 0049, non-normative requirements traceability, historical issue #12 snapshot, design index, and reproducible design-only manifest landed without workflow artifacts.

nodes.title: Shared semantic contract accepted
nodes.summary: Completed after issue #12 publication revision 2 was verified against clean PR #126 authority: normative contract and ADR 0049 at merge 62c2b23, non-normative traceability under docs/notes, manifest blob 25f2740, and SHA-256 085deed8.

nodes.title: Supported Application Client core
nodes.summary: Completed through issues #129 and #124 and PR #132 at head 6fd3c1133948f0cefe83948947f2d85d2db0a298, merged as 4ecbe84e99e00ab0cea3bcf3619d539c222746af: one supported typed core implements AC-C01 through AC-C20 across SQLite and Postgres, including the extensible membership-loss model and regenerated bundle.

nodes.title: First supported Rust binding
nodes.summary: Completed through issue #149 and PR #151 at exact reviewed head c03db454781164f47a20e997665fe1251e07bd15, merged as ddedfab57cc305a1e91a81d7e49e712bb36d32fd. The root telex crate now exposes telex::application_client with supported defaults-disabled backend profiles, caller-owned Tokio, cancellation-safe lifecycle evidence, source compatibility guidance, and no external binding or private fallback.

nodes.title: Application Client conformance and migration
nodes.summary: Ready but unlaunched under issue #152. One node and PR must prove all ten accepted semantic families through the public Rust surface across isolated SQLite and credentialed Postgres, include public-only Watcher send-only and Station bidirectional fixtures, repair missing shared semantics in the same PR, and provide temporary-seam replacement guidance without introducing a duplicate framework or product implementation.

nodes.title: Supported client is consumable by both product workstreams
nodes.summary: After client-conformance completes, Watcher and Operator Station independently attest the same exact reviewed and green conformance head against their merged contracts and confirm that no CLI, raw IPC, spike helper, product DTO promotion, or product-private client is required. This is pre-product-integration consumability evidence, not product implementation, usability, packaging, or operational proof.

nodes.title: Application Client operational hardening
nodes.summary: Harden packaging, install/upgrade, diagnostics, cleanup, resource bounds, credentialed Postgres, delayed or duplicated delivery, process replacement, and additional binding ergonomics after both consumers can integrate. Sketch; detail after the consumer gate.

nodes.title: Application Client workstream reconciled
nodes.summary: Builder accepts the supported client, conformance evidence, consumer integration, migration guidance, and operational hardening, then reconciles durable lessons into both product workstreams and campaign closure.

checkpoints.title: Supported client core and binding consumable
